description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Quevera is hiring a Junior Software Engineer to support corporate operations through software development, AI, systems integration, and process automation. The role develops practical technical solutions, improves business processes and operational efficiency, and supports internal IT operations.
Junior Software Engineer developing internal software and AI automation, integrating enterprise systems via APIs, and supporting application implementations

Responsibilities:
• Develop, test, implement, and maintain internal software applications, scripts, and technical solutions
• Leverage AI, machine learning, and automation technologies to improve business processes and operational efficiency
• Develop system integrations utilizing APIs, communication protocols, and data exchange technologies
• Collaborate with corporate departments to identify business needs and deliver technical solutions
• Support enterprise application implementations, configurations, data migrations, and integrations
• Research and evaluate emerging technologies to support corporate innovation and scalability
• Provide internal IT support, troubleshoot technical issues, and coordinate with external IT service providers as needed
• Maintain technical documentation, procedures, and system configurations
• Adhere to company cybersecurity, data privacy, and compliance standards

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
• 0–2 years of relevant experience, including internships and academic projects
• Foundational programming experience with Python, JavaScript, Java, C#, or similar languages
• Understanding of APIs, databases, software development, and systems integration
• Familiarity with AI technologies and process automation
• Basic knowledge of networking, operating systems, and IT troubleshooting
• Strong problem-solving, communication, and analytical skills

Preferred:
• Familiarity with generative AI, large language models (LLMs), and AI-assisted development
• Experience with Microsoft 365, Azure, Power Platform, or similar enterprise technologies
• Familiarity with SQL, Git, and automation tools
• Understanding of cybersecurity best practices and government contracting environments
